tasks.label: verify-local-coverage
args: import { StructuredStore } from './src/store.ts'; import { parseInput } from './src/parser.ts'; import { applyCoverageDefaults } from './src/coverage-resolvers.ts'; import { proposeCoverageUrl } from './src/url-enrichment.ts'; const store=new StructuredStore('./data/store.json'); await store.load(); const opto=store.snapshot.coverage.filter(r=>r.clientName==='Opto'); const source=opto.find(r=>r.articleTitle==='How Advisors Are Putting Private Markets to Use'); const raw={Date:source.publicationDate,Title:source.articleTitle,Client:source.clientName,'Media Outlet':source.outlet,Reporter:source.reporterName,Spokesperson:source.spokesperson}; const parsed=parseInput(JSON.stringify(raw),'derived-from-store.json').items[0]; const resolved=applyCoverageDefaults(parsed,[{name:source.outlet,uvm:7400000,link:'https://example.test'}]); const urlCheck=await proposeCoverageUrl({...source,articleUrl:'https://existing.test/article'},undefined); const allowed=new Set(['Earned Coverage','Contributed Content','Podcast Interview','Awards & Recognition','Speaking Engagement','Newsletter Inclusion','Press Release','Press Release & Earned Coverage Syndication','Missed Opportunity']); const bad=store.snapshot.coverage.filter(r=>!allowed.has(r.coverageType)||r.sentiment!=='Positive'||r.status!=='Live'||(r.articleUrl&&r.articleUrl===r.articleTitle)); console.log(JSON.stringify({storeCount:store.snapshot.coverage.length,optoCount:opto.length,sourceId:source.id,parsed:{publicationDate:parsed.publicationDate,articleTitle:parsed.articleTitle,clientName:parsed.clientName,outlet:parsed.outlet,reporterName:parsed.reporterName,spokesperson:parsed.spokesperson,articleUrl:parsed.articleUrl},resolved:{coverageType:resolved.coverageType,sentiment:resolved.sentiment,status:resolved.status,reach:resolved.reach},explicitReach:applyCoverageDefaults({...parsed,reach:123},[{name:source.outlet,uvm:7400000,link:''}]).reach,urlPreserved:urlCheck.proposedUrl,badCanonicalCount:bad.length}));
